claim_scope: For any alphabets of sizes m,n>=2, alternating length-four consecutive-two-deletion covering requires exactly ceil(m*n/3) codewords; the ordinary q-ary case specializes to ceil(q*q/3).
integrity: Finite construction verified with a separate exact-lower-bound proof; full unrestricted correctness follows from symbolic induction. Originality and value received self-review only; neither human nor independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Length four only; exactly one pair of consecutive deleted positions; no claim about unique decoding or nonconsecutive deletions. Divisible-by-three edge decompositions are prior work; an unindexed earlier graph path-cover theorem could overlap.
title: Sharp length-four consecutive-two-deletion covering for alternating alphabets
